regions.text: 凡丸藥云如細麻者即胡麻也不必扁扁略相稱爾黍粟亦然云如大麻子者准三細麻也如胡荳者即今青斑豆也以二大麻准之如
regions.translation: Whenever pill medicines are said to be the size of a fine hemp seed, this means sesame (huma); they need not be flat—being roughly comparable suffices. The same holds for glutinous millet and foxtail millet. When said to be the size of a hemp seed (dama), reckon it as three fine hemp seeds. The size of a hu bean means what is today the green speckled bean; reckon it as two hemp seeds. As for the size of

regions.text: 小豆者今赤小豆也以三大麻准之如大豆者以二小豆准之如梧子者以二大豆准之如彈丸及雞子黃者以四十梧子准之
regions.translation: the small bean—this is today's red small bean (adzuki)—reckon it as three hemp seeds. The size of a soybean is reckoned as two small beans. The size of a wutong seed is reckoned as two soybeans. The size of a crossbow pellet or of an egg yolk is reckoned as forty wutong seeds.
[Kou] Zongshi says: When people today use

regions.text: 古方多不効者何也不知古人之意蓋如仲景治胸痺心中痞堅逆氣搶心用治中湯人參朮乾薑甘草四物共一十二兩水八升煮取三升每服一升日三服以知為度或作丸須雞子黃大[?]竒効今人以一丸如楊梅許服之病既不去乃曰藥不神非藥之罪用藥之罪也
regions.translation: ancient formulas they are often ineffective—why is this? They do not understand the intent of the ancients. For instance, when [Zhang] Zhongjing treated chest obstruction with hard fullness below the heart and rebellious qi rushing at the heart, he used Regulate-the-Middle Decoction: ginseng, atractylodes, dried ginger, and licorice, four ingredients totaling twelve liang, boiled in eight sheng of water down to three sheng, one sheng per dose, three doses a day, taking perceptible effect as the measure. Or, if made into pills, they had to be the size of an egg yolk [?] remarkable effect. People today take a single pill about the size of a bayberry, and when the illness does not depart they say the medicine has no power. It is not the fault of the medicine, but the fault of how the medicine is used.

regions.text: 凡方云巴豆若干枚者粒有大小當去心皮秤之以一分准十六枚附子烏頭若干枚者去皮畢以半兩准一枚枳實若干枚者去穰畢
regions.translation: Whenever a formula calls for a certain number of badou (croton) seeds: the grains vary in size, so one should remove the core and skin and weigh them, reckoning one fen as sixteen seeds. For a certain number of pieces of fuzi (aconite lateral root) or wutou (aconite main tuber), after removing the skin reckon one piece as half a liang. For a certain number of pieces of zhishi (immature bitter orange), after removing the pulp,

regions.text: 以一分准二枚橘皮一分准三枚棗大小三枚准一兩乾薑一累者以一兩為正
regions.translation: reckon one fen as two pieces. For tangerine peel (jupi), one fen equals three pieces. For jujubes, three of assorted large and small size equal one liang. For dried ginger, one connected strand is taken as one liang standard.

regions.text: 凡方云半夏一升者洗畢秤五兩為正蜀椒一升三兩為正吳茱萸一升五兩為正兎絲子一升九兩為正菴蘭子一升四兩為正蛇床
regions.translation: Whenever a formula says one sheng of banxia (pinellia): after washing, five liang by weight is the standard. One sheng of Sichuan pepper (shujiao): three liang is the standard. One sheng of wuzhuyu (evodia): five liang is the standard. One sheng of tusizi (dodder seed): nine liang is the standard. One sheng of [anlü] seed [菴蘭, likely for anlüzi, Artemisia keiskeana]: four liang is the standard. Cnidium

regions.text: 子一升三兩半為正地膚子一升四兩為正其子各有虛實輕重不可秤准者取平升為正
regions.translation: seed (shechuangzi), one sheng: three and a half liang is the standard. Difuzi (kochia seed), one sheng: four liang is the standard. Since such seeds each differ in hollowness or solidity, lightness or heaviness, for those that cannot be standardized by weighing, a level sheng is taken as the standard.

regions.text: 凡方云用桂一尺者削去皮重半兩為正甘草一尺者二兩為正云某草一束者三兩為正云一把者二兩為正
regions.translation: Whenever a formula says to use one chi (foot) of cinnamon bark: after paring away the outer skin, half a liang by weight is the standard. For one chi of licorice: two liang is the standard. When it says one bundle of a certain herb, three liang is the standard; when it says one handful, two liang is the standard.

regions.text: 凡方云蜜一斤者有七合豬膏一斤者有一升二合也
regions.translation: Whenever a formula says one jin (catty) of honey, that amounts to seven ge; one jin of lard amounts to one sheng and two ge.

regions.text: 凡丸散藥亦先切細曝燥乃擣之有各擣者有合擣者並隨方其潤濕藥如天門冬地黃輩皆先增分兩切曝獨擣碎更出擘若逢陰雨
regions.translation: For pill and powder medicines, likewise first cut the drugs fine and dry them in the sun, and only then pound them. Some are pounded separately, some pounded together—in every case follow the formula. Moist drugs such as tianmendong (asparagus root) and dihuang (rehmannia) should all first have their weight allowance increased, then be cut, sun-dried, and pounded to pieces on their own, then taken out and torn apart. If one meets with overcast, rainy weather,

regions.text: 火烘之既燥小停冷乃擣之
regions.translation: dry them over a fire; once they are dry, let them cool a little while, and then pound them.

regions.text: 時珍曰凡諸草木藥及滋補藥並忌鐵器金性尅木之生發之氣肝腎受傷也唯宜銅刀竹刀修治乃佳亦有忌銅器者正宜如法凡散須用青石碾石磨石臼其砂石者不良
regions.translation: [Li] Shizhen says: All herbal and woody drugs, and all nourishing tonic drugs, must avoid iron implements: metal's nature overcomes wood, [injuring] the qi of generation and growth, and the liver and kidneys suffer harm. Only copper knives or bamboo knives are suitable for their preparation; that is best. There are also drugs that must avoid copper implements—one should proceed exactly according to the proper method. All powders require a green-stone roller, stone mill, or stone mortar; those made of sandstone are inferior.

regions.text: 凡篩丸藥用重密絹各篩畢更合於臼中擣數百遍色理和同乃佳也巴豆杏仁胡麻諸膏膩藥皆熬擣令如膏[?][?]切[?][?]
regions.translation: Whenever sifting pill medicines, use doubled fine-mesh silk; after each has been sifted, combine them again in a mortar and pound several hundred times; when color and texture are evenly blended, it is good. Badou (croton), apricot kernel, sesame, and all such rich, greasy drugs should be roasted and pounded until like a paste [?][?] cut [?][?].
